Dear Sirs, 
 
 
Sub.:  Audio recording of Q2 / H1 FY27 Earnings Call

15 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and

uploaded audio recording of the Q2 / H1 FY27 Earnings Call held on Tuesday,
